siteName: Askja & Holuhraun Volcanic Highlands, Iceland (Copernicus GLO-30 High-Latitude Supplement)

provenance.datasetName: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (High-Latitude Supplement for NASADEM >60°N / <56°S cutoff)
provenance.provider: ESA / Copernicus Open Data Registry (NASADEM latitude limit supplement)
provenance.processingPerformed: Extracted 3840 m × 3840 m window via HTTP Range read from Copernicus_DSM_COG_10_N65_00_W017_00_DEM (NASADEM out-of-bounds north of 60°N) and bilinearly resampled onto 30.0 m EPSG:32628 (UTM Zone 28N) grid. NASADEM coverage check: OUT_OF_BOUNDS (NASADEM_HGT V001 ends at 60°N due to SRTM shuttle inclination; supplemented by real 30 m Copernicus GLO-30 tile N65W017).
provenance.resamplingMethod: Bilinear interpolation onto 30.0 m metric grid
provenance.limitations: OUT_OF_BOUNDS (NASADEM_HGT V001 ends at 60°N due to SRTM shuttle inclination; supplemented by real 30 m Copernicus GLO-30 tile N65W017)
